verdict: key consistent: 40 signs for 41 letters (one alif of الاحباب not written), 11 groups = 11 words; one letter per shape; the ring S7 serves ي and the hamza seat ئ (عائد twice); needs the plaintext completed with 'لي وعائد'
notes: Rows: 10v segmenter lines 12-13 (the record's folio lines 13-14) and 11r l.1. Measured 14+13+13 = 40 signs (record 37) and 10 dividers (record 11). Record errors: (1) the enciphered verse continues after طبيب with لي (S2 S7) and وعائد (S15 S11 S5 S7 S12, spelled as عائد in the first hemistich with و added): the 'interlinear وعابد' after the plaintext line is this وعائد, part of the verse, and the record's plaintext stops 7 letters short. The verse is هل زماني بلقا الأحباب عائد / ملّ من سقمي طبيب لي وعائد (عائد = 'returning' and 'one who visits the sick'), and 'وعابد' is a misreading of وعائد; (2) الاحباب has 6 signs: the second ا is not written (S5 S2 S10 S8 S5 S8 = ا ل ح ب ا ب). S10 (U, ح) has a small brown ring over it, a later addition, not counted as a sign. S4 (one-dot stem, م) is a sign, not a divider: it stands where م is wanted four times. A brown dot near S2 in بلقا and a dash beside the divider after عائد are stains.
